semiconductor_relevance: High — SAW Components Dresden specializes in thin-film technology and nanostructuring, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: SAW Components Dresden GmbH is a microelectronics company with over 30 years of experience in thin-film technology and nanostructuring, providing innovative solutions to customers worldwide. The company emphasizes sustainability, quality, and flexibility, supported by advanced production and testing infrastructure.

regional_presence.Germany: The company is based in Germany and serves customers globally.
